about.p1: I am a Fullstack Developer with over 5 years of experience, passionate about building and optimizing web applications, working on both backend and frontend. My main expertise lies in the .NET ecosystem (Core and Framework) with C#, and in relational databases like SQL Server.
about.p2: I have solid experience with architectures like MVC, MVVM, and CQRS, and I am proficient in modern web technologies, including JavaScript, TypeScript, and frameworks like Angular and React. I have practical experience with DevOps tools like Azure DevOps, Docker, Git, and Heroku, always aiming to deliver efficient, scalable, and high-performance solutions. Currently studying Systems Analysis and Development at IBMR and holding a Technical degree in Informatics from Cefet/RJ.

projects.horus.description: Telegram assistant chatbot capable of understanding natural language and extracting information about appointments directly from images (OCR), as well as managing reminders.
projects.horus.modal.about.p1: Horus is a personal Telegram chatbot project developed as an intelligent virtual assistant.  The objective is to simplify daily tasks, offering a conversational interface for managing appointments and quickly extracting information.
projects.horus.modal.challenges.p1: One of the main challenges was ensuring the accuracy of text extraction (OCR) from images with varied handwriting. This was addressed using the Gemini API and applying post-processing to validate the extracted date and time formats. Another challenge was managing conversations efficiently, which was solved with message history in Redis and PostgreSQL.
projects.horus.modal.features.f1: Image Text Extraction (OCR): Ability to analyze uploaded images (such as photos of notes or cards) and extract key information, such as dates and times of appointments.
projects.horus.modal.features.f2: Natural Language Understanding (NLP): Interacts with the user in a more natural way, understanding requests and intentions without the need for strictly formatted commands.
projects.horus.modal.features.f3: Reminder Management: Allows the user to request the creation of reminders for their commitments (either by text or extracted from an image).
projects.horus.modal.features.f4: Telegram Conversational Interface: Direct interaction via the messaging platform.

projects.oncall.description: Interactive frontend demonstration for a system managing schedules, teams, and on-call notifications, focused on user experience and interface design.
projects.oncall.modal.about.p1: This project is a demonstration of the user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) design for a complete on-call management system. The objective is to present a visually organized and intuitive solution to facilitate the management of on-call schedules, teams, notifications, and activity history.
projects.oncall.modal.about.p2: The demo was built using HTML, Tailwind CSS, and pure JavaScript to simulate the navigation and appearance of the different sections of the planned final application.
projects.oncall.modal.intendedFeatures.f: Real integration with Backend (.NET) and Database.
Complex logic for creating and managing schedules (rules, swaps).
Multi-channel notification system (Email, Push, SMS - optional).
